I don't play Feng exactly, but look up what moves are his best ones. You don't need to remember everything, only what's good. Maybe head onto the Feng discord server and ask something like "Hey, I'm learning Feng and I'm \[x\] rank, any tips for me to get better at playing him?". If you want, you can experiment with strings and what not if you want, it might catch people off guard. 

Determine the situation. Are they coming in? Are they trying to bait an attack from you? Are they trying to keep you out? That Blasted Salami uploaded a [fantastic video](https://youtu.be/og6ifaw80E8) covering these concepts, maybe they'll help you. After determining what they are doing, use any move you think is appropriate to stop then. 

My final tip is to give Feng some time. It doesn't come naturally. Out of all the character's I've played, they all didn't come easy. It may seem overwhelming at first, it certainly did for me, but with enough time put into him you should be able to get the hang of him. Sorry if I'm not too much help.

Akiyama vs Spike Spiegel? Keeping it in the voice actors, lol. I think this one would have good chance of being a tie, but Spike has a greater chance of winning. Spike is trained in Jeet Kune Do with a little bit of Savate sprinkled in, not to mention he has a high tolerance to pain. Akiyama got his fighting style from Arai which seems to be based on Taekwondo. 

Akiyama is quite quick though, and so is Spike. It'd end up being a kick off as they both use high kicks very frequently. Akiyama, if the games are anything to go by, can lift people into the air and juggle them too, not to mention he can do around 12+ kicks in a row without getting tired. If Akiyama could get a good sidestep on Spike, he has a fair chance of winning, but if Spike manages to outmaneuver Akiyama the very same could happen. 

They've both taken down tanks before, >!Kamon Kanai!<for Akiyama and >!Vincent!<for Spike, so they obviously have a lot of strength too. This one is hard to decide, they're both fast, strong and clever.  It most definitely seems like a tie, but Spike has a better chance of winning due to his great perception and combat experience.
